notes.title: Version 1.1 Released
notes.content:
Hello friends! Version 1.1 should be hitting your libraries here very shortly. You can read our full change list on our dev log [url=http://blog.fancypigeonstudios.com/posts/Version-1-1-Released/]here[/url].

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added five new plus-size levels. Our set designer felt we did all we could with the size of arena we had set previously, so we've blown up the scale so we could realise more interesting designs.
[*] Added three new playable characters. For those keeping score, that brings the total to four. Now you're able to play a full game with each player having a unique skin if that's your jam.
[*] Added three new weapons: Automatic, Laser, and Sniper
[*] Added a new game mode: Bounty
[/list]

notes.title: Shoot Your Friends - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

Today we're dropping a small update to better serve you shooting each other:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where selecting "Rematch" in Last Team Standing mode would cause the next round to end after a few seconds.
[*] Fixed a bug where selecting "Rematch" in Juggernaut gave the previous winner an advantage.
[/list]
